text:
alex_oncall: heads-up: we're seeing degraded GPU capacity in eu-west-1 starting ~1772501100. Autoscaler reports healthy but pods stuck in Pending due to scheduling failures. Also missing a bunch of node-level metrics in prometheus.
maya_sre: seeing the same. prometheus shows ~40% of eu-west node exporters DOWN. grafana dashboards for gpu_mem_free/kv_cache_size are flatlined.
paul_infra: looks like the k8s node-exporter sidecar rolled out a config change 10m ago (helm release infra-agent v2.3.1). new args dropped the /metrics path. checking rollout status.
ops-bot: deploy infra-agent/v2.3.1 reported 2026-03-18T10:45:21Z - 18/20 pods ready in eu-west1-autoscale-group.
alex_oncall: can we confirm if the GPU drivers or nvidia-exporter are impacted, or is it just node-exporter scrape path?
maya_sre: `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=infra-agent -o wide` shows several CrashLoopBackOffs for infra-agent on nodes with GPUs. logs show: `failed to bind 0.0.0.0:9100 - address already in use` and later `unable to serve metrics: listen tcp :9100: bind: address already in use`.
paul_infra: that's because we changed the hostPort logic in the daemonset and a different exporter got scheduled. rolling back infra-agent to v2.3.0 now.
alex_oncall: rollback started. immediate mitigation: shift new inference traffic away from eu-west to dedicated pools in eu-central and us-west. Can we apply routing override? @li_devex do we have a quick feature flag?
li_devex: switching smart-route policy to prefer(region_priority=[eu-central, us-west-1]) for customer-tier=hosted. Pushing now via console API. Should take effect for new requests. Old requests still on existing connections.
jess_product: we should send status update to customers on degraded latency for eu customers. recommend note that we’re routing to alternate regions.
ops-bot: route-change job queued: job_id=rc-20260318-77.
maya_sre: prom scrapes returning 503 for many targets due to infra-agent crash. Because prometheus lost node-level metrics, the autoscaler didn't see free GPU memory (gpu_mem_free) and therefore refused to scale. This is a gap: autoscaler should have a fallback to kube-scheduler allocatable + node utilization.
paul_infra: agreed. immediate: I've re-applied the hostPort fix and restarted infra-agent pods on the affected nodes. running `kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/infra-agent`.
alex_oncall: runbook note: if prometheus scrape count drops >25% in a region, trigger controlled traffic tilt and run diagnostics. That didn't happen because we only alert on prometheus down for >50%. lowering threshold is a TODO.
maya_sre: after restart, node-exporter and nvidia-exporter metrics are slowly returning for ~60% of nodes. autoscaler now sees gpu_mem_free on recovered nodes and is allowing new pods.
paul_infra: to prevent recurrence, we'll: 1) revert the net/bind change in infra-agent config, 2) add a readiness probe that checks `/metrics` before marking ready, 3) add synthetic prometheus exporters for gpu_mem_free derived from nvidia-smi if exporter missing.
li_devex: will add a runtime feature flag to allow forced-region fallback for customers and docs on costs. note: traffic tilt to other regions will increase cross-region egress and warmup costs. cost owner ping: @jess_product.
jess_product: ack. please capture estimated delta for a 2-hour tilt at peak qps; product will decide on communications.
ops-bot: incident created in incidents-tracker: INC-2026-0318-13.
alex_oncall: postmortem action items (short): 1) add autoscaler fallback heuristics (use node allocatable + kube-scheduler observations) 2) add alert for prometheus scrape target drop >20% per region 3) add infra-agent readiness check & hostPort validation 4) publish runbook step to tilt traffic + cost estimate template 5) add canary rollout gating for infra-agent daemonset
maya_sre: I'll own #2 and #1 with help from paul. Target: patch + tests by EOD tomorrow.
paul_infra: I'll open the infra-agent rollback PR + add readiness probe.
li_devex: I'll update the routing docs and add an emergency toggle endpoint.
alex_oncall: thanks all. monitoring: keep thread updated with key milestones. If any node shows persistent exporter failures ping me directly. :fire:
maya_sre: updating slack status: eu-west partial recovery; autoscaler accepting new pods; still monitoring kv_cache metrics for regressions.
paul_infra: PR linked: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/infra-agent/pull/412 - includes hostPort fix & readiness probe.
alex_oncall: final note: this incident surfaced an observability blindspot where a config change took out metrics that other systems depended on. We'll cover in postmortem. Closing updates in ~1h if stable.
